{"metadata":{"description":"use glm/minimax/openai/claude api in your deepseek harness","id":"gh:1334636535","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"deepseek-harness-media","slug":"lo2589/deepseek-harness-media","topics":["ai-tools","anthropic","claude","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins","glm","llm-gateway","llm-provider","local-llm","minimax","multimodal","ollama","openai","openai-compatible","screenshot","vision","vision-language-model"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"use glm/minimax/openai/claude api in your deepseek harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Provider Quick Config — a dsh dynamic plugin"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文版 | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **Plugin source lives in this repo**: `plugin/` holds the dynamic-plugin form (`host.js` = Host ha"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"lf, `client.js` = Client half, `manifest.json` = restorable definition); **`dsh-provider-quick-confi"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"g/` is the formally installable npm package** (Host via `dsh.bundle`, Web UI via `dsh.client`) — **z"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ero changes to deepseek-harness source** (the repo's tracked files show no modifications; it is byte"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"-identical to the cloud `origin/master`)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Screenshot"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Two ways to use this plugin"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| | Dynamic plugin (quick/dev) | **Formal install (recommended, permanent)** |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Install | `cordis_define` in a session + approve the Run card | npm package installed into the `we"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"b` profile |
| Lifetime | current harness process only — **lost on restart** | **survives restarts**"},{"id":"p8s3","text":", permanent |
| Communication | `harness.handle` / `host.call` (sandbox RPC) | standard wire (`conne"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ction.api`: settings / credentials / llm) |
| Source | `plugin/` | `dsh-provider-quick-config/` |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Formal install (already done on this machine)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The package was built, packed (`dsh-provider-quick-config-0.5.4.tgz`) and installed into the `web` p"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"kage was built, packed (`dsh-provider-quick-config-0.5.4.tgz`) and installed into the `web` profile:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`dsh plugin add` runs `pnpm add` in the profile and appends the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` whe"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"n it declares `dsh.bundle.patch`. Verify:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Then restart `dsh web`** (e.g. `deepseek.sh restart`) — the Host half mounts from the profile bund"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"le, and `dsh-client-modules` serves the Web half at `/plugins/dsh-provider-quick-config/client.js`. "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"After restart: the **+** button appears next to Send (no per-session approval needed anymore)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Update after code changes: bump the version, re-pack, `dsh plugin --profile web add file:…<new>.tgz`"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" (or update the dependency spec + `pnpm install`), restart.
Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web rem"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ove dsh-provider-quick-config`, restart."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"A **+** button next to the **Send** button in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. Click it to configure mo"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"del providers without touching config files by hand:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- List every configured provider route (`llm-pi-ai.providers.*`) with credential status and the mode"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ls each one serves.
- **One-click vendor presets**: 智谱 GLM, MiniMax, OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, L"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ocal models (Ollama) — endpoint / protocol / thinkingFormat / model list are pre-filled.
- **Model p"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"icker**: per-vendor quick-model chips (click to select/deselect) plus free-form rows (id / ctx / max"},{"id":"p17s5","text":") — e.g. switch MiniMax to **M3** by clicking the `MiniMax-M3` chip, no JSON editing.
- **Auto-valid"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ate model names on save (ping)**: before saving, the plugin queries the endpoint's `GET /models` and"},{"id":"p17s7","text":" compares (case/dash-insensitive). A model that does not exist (e.g. typing `glm4.6v` instead of `GL"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"M-4.6`) fails with a red error and **blocks the save**. Endpoints that do not support listing are sk"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"ipped and saved normally.
- **Auto-load local models**: picking the Ollama preset immediately fetche"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"s `GET /models` and fills the form (a "Fetch models" button exists on every custom route too).
[该节后续"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"GET /models` and fills the form (a "Fetch models" button exists on every custom route too).
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## How it works (no harness code changes — pure config files, hot-reload)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The plugin does not invent its own config store; it drives the two seams the harness already ships:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Action | Written to | Effect |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Add / edit / delete routes | `llm-pi-ai.providers` in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` | settings `mutate"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"` → file persisted → the `llm-pi-ai` adapter's watcher re-registers — **live on the next request** |"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"
| Save / update API keys | `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` (0600) | credentials `set` → file is watch"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"API keys | `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` (0600) | credentials `set` → file is watched, hot-reloads |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Only **credential references (environment-variable names)** are stored by the plugin; key values go "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"straight into `.credentials.yaml` and never come back to the GUI."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Route writes go through `settings.mutate`, which validates against the `llm-pi-ai` namespace schema "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"+ `assertServiceable`: a wrong protocol, empty baseURL, or invalid model is **rejected at write time"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"** — a broken route can never be stored."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Install / run"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"1. Approve the Run card in this session (single check is enough; double check auto-runs future versi"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ons).
2. Refresh the page — the **+** appears in the composer's tool row, next to the model selector"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" / send button.
3. Click **+** → Add Provider → pick a preset or custom → fill the form → Save."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"> The official **Settings → Models** page still works alongside; this plugin is the quick entry poin"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"t beside the input box."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Restoring the plugin after a process restart"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Dynamic plugins live only in process memory: **restarting `dsh web` removes `pprov-1`**. Restore fro"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"m this repo (the source never goes away):"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"1. `code.host` ← full content of `plugin/host.js`
2. `code.client` ← full content of `plugin/client."},{"id":"p29s2","text":"js`
3. Re-define with `cordis_define` (`kind: "new"`, `idPrefix: "pprov"`; copy `name` / `purpose` f"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"rom `plugin/manifest.json`), then `cordis_run`."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Your configuration (`~/.dsh/settings.yaml` + `.credentials.yaml`) is untouched, so routes reappear i"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"uration (`~/.dsh/settings.yaml` + `.credentials.yaml`) is untouched, so routes reappear immediately."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Form fields"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Field | Notes |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Route key | Unique id (the `providers` dict key); arbitrary, **immutable after save**. Multiple ke"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ys per vendor (glm1 / glm2 …) |
| Display name | Shown in the model picker; defaults to the key |
| "},{"id":"p33s3","text":"Credential ref | Environment-variable name, e.g. `GLM_API_KEY`; resolved per request through credent"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"ials |
| API key | Optional. Filled → written to `.credentials.yaml`; empty → keep existing / rely o"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"n env |
| API protocol | Custom routes pick one: `openai-completions` / `openai-responses` / `anthro"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"pic-messages` |
| BaseURL | Required for custom routes |
| thinkingFormat | Reasoning-field dialect "},{"id":"p33s7","text":"for `openai-completions`: `openai / deepseek / openrouter / together / zai / qwen / string-thinking "},{"id":"p33s8","text":"/ ant-ling`. Hand-write when the endpoint URL is unrecognized (MiniMax → `deepseek`, Zhipu → `zai`) "},{"id":"p33s9","text":"|
| Models | Custom routes need ≥1: `[{ "id": "…", "contextWindow": 131072, "maxTokens": 32768 }]` |"}],"truncated":true}
